summary: Nothing new worth a permanent look; Mobimeo's Java role from earlier sweeps is not due for a recheck. New freelance at 6: a 100% remote Java/Kubernetes project with team coaching (One Day Ahead), a mobility-platform Java 21/Spring Boot project offered by Randstad and mund, and a part-time Java/Azure migration with product ownership (WeMatch). Google Jobs failed (five 503s); nothing new on the Italian lane. Review: 1 dropped (mund ID03603, onsite 20% a year in Frankfurt), Randstad AFRA #285 remote score lowered to 1 for its 5% onsite (total 5), Divio and Talent 4.0 countries corrected to what the posting says (CH, EU) and Divio's unsourced pay range replaced with StepStone 2026 figures, gaps rewritten in the postings' words for five roles.
